info.title: ARGOS integration contracts (schemas only)
info.description: Edge->Core events, Core read models, MLOps contracts. No paths: Core endpoints are specified in docs/integration-contracts.md.

AIPrediction.description: Snapshot of the quality inference that produced a part verdict. Immutable.
AIPrediction.title: AIPrediction

Alert.description: One alert EPISODE (grouped detections), managed by the Alert Manager (ARGOS-02B).
Alert.title: Alert

uri.description: MLflow artifact URI or file path inside the package
uri.title: Uri

DangerZone.description: A polygon in normalized image coordinates, configured per camera.
DangerZone.title: DangerZone

DatasetRef.description: A versioned dataset (DVC tag/commit or manifest hash). Never the data itself.

version.description: DVC tag/commit, or sha256 of the manifest
version.title: Version

uri.description: DVC remote path or storage URI (no public URL)
uri.title: Uri

DatasetRef.title: DatasetRef

EdgeEvent.description:
Envelope of every Edge -> Core event. Header fields are copied from the payload
so that Core can index and route events without parsing every payload kind.
EdgeEvent.title: EdgeEvent

EdgeEventBatch.description: POST /ingest/v1/events body. Events are sorted by edge_sequence.
EdgeEventBatch.title: EdgeEventBatch

EvaluationMetrics.description: Evaluation of one run on one dataset split (logged in MLflow, mirrored here).
EvaluationMetrics.title: EvaluationMetrics

Event.description: An analysis result after the decision layer: this is what is stored and served.
Event.title: Event

FrameMeta.description: Metadata of one image coming from a source.
FrameMeta.title: FrameMeta

IngestAck.description:
Core answer. The Edge marks ``accepted`` and ``duplicate`` events as delivered;
``rejected`` events stay in the outbox flagged for investigation (never dropped).

highest_contiguous_sequence.description: Highest edge_sequence such that all previous ones are stored
highest_contiguous_sequence.title: Highest Contiguous Sequence

IngestAck.title: IngestAck

ModelDeployment.description: Request to run a model version on a station. Always approved by a human first.
ModelDeployment.title: ModelDeployment

ModelPackage.description:
Everything an Edge needs to run a model, delivered by MLOps (``model-package.json``).

The Edge loads ``analyzer_class`` with ``params`` (merged with ``artifact`` path) and
refuses the package if the artifact sha256 does not match.
ModelPackage.title: ModelPackage

ModelRef.description: Pointer to an MLflow registered model version.
ModelRef.title: ModelRef

ModelStatusPayload.description: Which model version a station actually runs (reported after each (re)load).
ModelStatusPayload.title: ModelStatusPayload

human_agreement_rate.description: Share of human-reviewed parts where human == AI
human_agreement_rate.title: Human Agreement Rate

OperatorReport.description: An operator report as stored by Core (with its station and status).
OperatorReport.title: OperatorReport

OperatorReportPayload.description: A problem reported by the operator to the supervisor. Free text, no identity.
OperatorReportPayload.title: OperatorReportPayload

Part.description: One physical part presented by a PLC cycle.
Part.title: Part

PersonPPE.description: One detected person. Position in the image only: NO identity, NO face data.

person_index.description: Index in this frame only, not a tracking id
person_index.title: Person Index

PersonPPE.title: PersonPPE

PersonPPEExtension.description: Extra PPE items for one person (same person_index as PersonPPE).
PersonPPEExtension.title: PersonPPEExtension

ProductionKPI.description:
Production indicators over a window. Rates are None when their denominator is 0.

Counts use the EFFECTIVE verdict; ``predicted_*`` counts keep the AI view.
HOLD and ERROR parts are never counted as OK nor as NOK.
ProductionKPI.title: ProductionKPI

heatmap_ref.description: Optional reference (path/URL) to a heatmap. Never inline.
heatmap_ref.title: Heatmap Ref

RetrainingPolicy.description: When to retrain automatically. Deployment ALWAYS needs a human approval.
RetrainingPolicy.title: RetrainingPolicy

StationDeploymentStatus.description: What a station ACTUALLY runs (from the model.status edge events).
StationDeploymentStatus.title: StationDeploymentStatus

simulated.description: Simulated stations are shown as such in the UI
simulated.title: Simulated

Thresholds.description: Two thresholds per use case: score < low -> conforme, score >= high -> anomalie.
Thresholds.title: Thresholds
